title: Signal: Request input written to a log call (php) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on request accessors inside log calls.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: flags a request accessor on the same line as a log call. A value copied to a variable on an earlier line is not seen.

examples.line: # audit: error_log("Failed to parse val=" . $_GET["val"]); present

fpNotes: Values already validated against a strict allowlist before logging are the common false positive.
